Server: raspberrypi.local:8000 primary (both it and 192.168.50.9 healthy, same Pi). Session e8e5722643f14e2d8816bdc7e6fee5f4 grounded; 6 learner turns of 10 budget.

WHAT IS NOW FIXED (live-confirmed): (1) T77-Fix error surfacing - NotFoundError reaches the model as error:not_found, no longer masked invalid_output. (2) A5-FIXED - after a plain correct answer (no move-on phrasing), advance_lesson{passed_check:true} fired IN THE SAME REPLY immediately after the answer and BEFORE any teaching prose; the prior wrong answer had produced remediation with no advance; server state really moved (rec_basics done -> call_stack current, nodes_since_check 0->1). A1/A3/A4 all PASS again.

THE REMAINING BROKEN LINK (A2): in the natural flow the model NEVER has run_probe's uuid question_ids at answer time. Turn 2 ('1: B; 2: I don't know'): 8 grade_answer calls, all with fabricated placeholder ids (q1_id_placeholder, q1_abc123, q1_probe_recursion_1, ...), ALL error:not_found, zero outcomes, and a fully silent 0-char assistant turn. Root cause verified in source, architectural, not promptable away: Session.model_dump() carries no messages field (session.py L184-200), _history_messages therefore always returns [] (messages.py L227-241), the [SESSION CONTEXT] block carries no pending-quiz state, and the uuids exist only inside the ephemeral role:'tool' loop message of the run_probe turn (turn.py L249-255) which is never persisted or re-injected - while answer_quiz demands an exact DB id (learning.py L143-148). 'Copy question_id VERBATIM from run_probe' is unsatisfiable across turns BY CONSTRUCTION. Isolation proof (turn 3): feeding the uuids inline in the learner message produced two successful gradings with real server outcomes (correct / idk, mastery updated) - tools layer is sound; only cross-turn context rehydration is broken. Fix direction for Turing: re-inject open quiz items (ids+truncated text) into the next turn's context (e.g. a [PENDING QUESTIONS] block or lesson_state), or let grade_answer resolve ordinal/pending items server-side.

Recommended fix ownership: Turing (context rehydration in app/llm/messages.py + app/services/sessions/turn.py), then re-run this exact harness.
